newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $109/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $109/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska's feedlot cattle market was slow, with light sales at $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources said.
About 900 head of slaughter steers that will likely grade select and choice sold Friday morning, they said.

Most of the week's volume was traded on Wednesday with a top of $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, but the bulk sold at $110.00 to $111.00, the sources said. Cattle next week were expected to be priced from $111.00 to $112.00, they said.
Weekly volume was pegged near 84,000 head. This week's showlist had been estimated near 85,000 head.
